accuracy.evidence: Matches Y1 measure: compare lengths/heights; non-standard units end to end; line up starts; length ≠ height vocabulary.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets far-ends-only, gaps/mixed units, taller≠longer, and heavier≠longer in predictions, fair step, challenge why(), and adult notes.

lab_distinct.evidence: Lab is line-up + longer/taller + cube units for length/height — distinct from full/empty capacity (flagheavy) and perimeter (flagperim).

lab_teaches.evidence: Learner must line up starts, pick longer and taller, lay five cubes, fix fair start/unit, then confirm with the true-idea step.

predictions.evidence: Wrong options (far ends only; taller=longer; gaps OK; units unnecessary) are overturned by lineup/cubes/fair tasks.

challenge_feedback.evidence: why() names ends/flip, tall/flat swap, heavy/mass/colour, gaps/mix, and pretty/skip slips specifically.

readability.evidence: Ages 5–6 wording: short kid lines, ribbon/tower/cube examples, length and height named plainly.

no_filler.evidence: No delve/journey phrasing; each line teaches compare, unit, or a slip to reject.

mobile.evidence: Large pick A/B and add-cube buttons; tap twins for drag; challenge stack works at phone width.

accessibility.evidence: Lineup, longer, taller, cubes, fair, and idea steps expose lbtn twins; say() updates canvas aria-label; challenge uses aria-live status.

sources: UK National Curriculum Mathematics Y1: Measurement — compare, describe and solve practical problems for lengths and heights; measure using non-standard units
NCETM / DfE Mathematics guidance Y1: length and height, comparing and measuring
BBC Bitesize KS1: measuring length and height with non-standard units
